question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Immerse
solution:
The correct answer is "**Involve.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meanings of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **Immerse means to involve oneself deeply in a particular activity or interest.(**तल्लीन**)**

 
 
• Example: I saw him fully immersed in his studies.
 
 
 
• Involve is a synonym of immerse.
 
• **"Involve" means to take part into something fully**.(सम्मिलित करना)
 
 
• Example: She likes to involve herself deeply in books.
 
 
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Emerge means to become visible or known. (उभरना)
 
• Distant means far away in space or time.(दूर)
 
• Uncover means to remove a cover or layer from something. (उजागर करना)
